caption: The drawing depicts a wooden figure with jointed limbs, painted in beige with red-tipped hands and feet, black hair, and a pink face with simple black eyes and red lips. The figure is shown with both arms raised, and its legs and arms are attached to the body with visible round joints. In the lower left corner, there is a smaller inset drawing of a red and beige egg-shaped object split open, revealing a miniature version of the same wooden figure inside. The background is plain and beige, and the artist's signature, "Eugene Croe," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Doll in the "Thimble Holder"
